annotations.title: Renting or buying a home in the Netherlands

description: Compares the net cost of renting and of buying a home in the Netherlands over a number of years: rent with yearly increases and the return on the down payment if it stays invested (after Box 3), against mortgage payments, maintenance, the mortgage interest deduction and the equity built up.

down_payment.description: Own money put in (also pays the buying costs), euros. Default 10% of the price.

fiscal_partner.description: Filing with a fiscal partner. Default false.

gross_income.description: Gross income of the person who deducts the mortgage interest, euros a year. Default 60000.

home_value_growth_percent.description: Yearly change in the home's value, %. Default 2.

interest_rate_percent.description: Mortgage interest rate, % a year. Default 3.9.

investment_return_percent.description: What the down payment would earn if invested instead, % a year. Default 4.

maintenance_percent.description: Yearly maintenance and owners' association costs, % of the value. Default 1.

property_value.description: Price of the home to buy, euros

name: rent_vs_buy_netherlands
title: Renting or buying a home in the Netherlands
